description: This file contains benchmarking code for various requantization functions used in quantized neural network operations, including setup, teardown, and multiple benchmark tests for different implementations and hardware architectures.

classes.name: Requantization
classes.description: A benchmarking fixture class for testing various requantization functions, managing input/output buffers, and cache-aware sizing.

methods.name: divideRoundUp
methods.description: Performs division with rounding up to the next integer.

methods.name: roundUp
methods.description: Rounds up a value to the nearest multiple of q.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two uint32_t values.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes input data and output buffer before each benchmark run.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Records processed items and bytes, clears input/output buffers after each benchmark run.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the input data array.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the output data array.

methods.name: n
methods.description: Returns the size of the input/output buffers.
